references.text: Salt is used as a metaphor to preserve and maintain the covenant with God, reflecting its use in Mark 9:50 as a symbol of preserving faith and relationships with one another.
Here the reader is encouraged to be a source of renewal and blessing for others, similar to how salt in Mark 9:50 calls for preserving goodness and peace.
Jesus uses salt as an image of the disciples' influence in the world, paralleling the call in Mark 9:50 to have salt within oneself and live in peace with one another.
The property of salt to season and preserve food is used as an analogy for the necessity of maintaining faithfulness, echoing the message in Mark 9:50 about preserving faith and relationships.
The call to live in peace with all people reflects the message in Mark 9:50 to have salt within oneself and to promote peaceful relationships.
